name: Inflection Incremental Pipeline Architecture
description: Re-architect the INF gold chain from full-rebuild-daily (~70min wall, ~1750 historical partition rewrites/day, ~35-40min wasted compute) to per-partition idempotence + append-only cumulative timeseries patterns. Target steady-state daily wall: 8-12 min Mon-Sat with weekly Sunday full-pull safety net. Five architectural patterns (A: date-partitioned canonical skip-gate, B: cumulative timeseries blob append-only, C: per-HH historical-replay anchor cache, D: latest-state dependency-skip, E: date-windowed API pulls). Six phases over ~3 weeks calendar / ~19 dev-days across DS~A + DS~B + AE 0.6.1. Each phase independently shippable + reversible via per-script env flag. Trigger: Andrew direct ASK during live chain_full_20260514_131842 ('make a truly incremental version of this flow rather than having to rebuild 7 years of history every single day, analyze every script in detail and write a comprehensive brief').

Phase 2-6 NOT YET AUTHORED — Phase 2 dispatch gates on Phase 1 RAVC2 + chain #30 mode=full wrap clean (DS~A INF_D_00c fix fd11a33c2 production-proven through one full chain). Open questions: Q1 (advisor attribution lag) + Q5 (DIAGFIX banner) + Q6 (validation epsilon budget) routed to CTO; Q2 (PULL_TXN/PERF trailing window empirical probe) routed to DS~B; Q3 (schema version stamping) + Q4 (partition_provenance.json layout) folded into Phase 1 TO scope per AE recommendation. blocking: (1) Phase 1 .001-.005 COMPLETE -- skip-gate lib + dispatch.sh flag plumbing (.001), Pattern A/B/C migrations (.002/.003/.004), Pattern E Orion REST capability probe (.005). (2) ADVI_INFINC.006 (Pattern E TXN account-windowed pull, DS~D) COMPLETE 2026-05-15 -- RAVC2 accepted (commit 5c1ea192d code + b7f86b7a5 brief/log, deployed to s3 manual_api/; account-windowed full-pull validated as a 1,299,831-row SUPERSET of bronze -- 0 rows lost, all 6 statuses, schema byte-identical, zero bronze-contract change; incremental reconciles row-for-row; AC8/AC9 demonstrated). CLOSED AS AN ARCHITECTURE MIGRATION, not a speed win: AC5 empirically ~1x not ~2x -- the daily path is ~862 sequential latency-bound calls and windowing cuts payload not call-count; the firm-endpoint call-count lever died (schema-incompatible). The architectural value -- windowed/idempotent/backdated-correct pull + the append-only-ingestion foundation (ADVI_TXNAMG section-7 Q5) -- is real and CTO-ratified worth-keeping; the project's daily-wall speed goal rides on Patterns A/B/C, not E. (3) Open questions Q1/Q5/Q6 CTO ruling (architectural calls); Q2 DS~B empirical Orion backdate distribution probe. (4) Phase 2-6 not yet authored. (5) NEW 2026-05-15 -- the INFINC.006 Phase-0 PERF short-window probe is POSITIVE (7d/14d windows on /Clients/{id}/Performance return in 1.5-2.0s, no timeout; brief docs/briefs/inf-pattern-e-perf-short-window-probe-20260515.md section-2); a PERF Pattern-E implementation TO is to be authored off this finding -- COO queue. (6) 2026-05-21 -- the systemic INFINC_REBUILD gate-value bug-class follow-on (CTO-ruled ADVI_INFINC home, surfaced by ADVI_INFGRO.009) COMPLETE + CTO RAVC-accepted: commit 43e13faf6; DS 0.4.0 added lib/skip_gate.rebuild_requested() shared helper and converged all 5 Pattern-B _force_rebuild gates (INF_C_02/C_03/D_05/D_06/D_09) onto it, retiring the re-inline-drift root cause; S3-deployed+verified. That follow-on TO is mis-numbered ADVI_INFINC.002 (collides with the complete Pattern-A migration .002) -- flagged to COO to renumber to the next free serial. NOTE: this ADVI_INFINC.json phase/blocking narrative predates several events and needs a fuller CTO reconciliation pass.
